message.content: The image shows a bright, watercolor-style kitchen scene centered on a large green kitchen island with a wooden countertop. On the countertop sit several cooking items: a small orange pot with a lid, a teal bowl, a yellow canister holding wooden spoons, a yellow canister holding a whisk and wooden utensils, a coral pot with a lid, another teal canister with wooden utensils, and a yellow canister with wooden utensils resting on a small pink saucer with a blue bowl. A wooden knife lies in front of the pots. Behind the counter are light green cabinets with small knobs, a white range hood at the upper left, a white stove with a green pot on it, a wooden cutting board leaning against the counter, and two lidded storage jars. A pink pendant lamp hangs from the ceiling, and a window on the right lets in daylight, with two potted green plants on the sill. The lower shelf beneath the island holds additional lidded containers. The overall setting is a tidy, warm, domestic kitchen.
